notes: Sourced primarily from Sound Devices' official MixPre II Series User Guide (Rev 4-D, 01/22), which includes a dedicated panel-view diagram and specifications table for the MixPre-10 II specifically. Device has 8 identical mic/line combo inputs (numbered 1-8 on the front-panel gain knobs); listed individually. Two connector types required best-fit mapping to the allowed id list: the rear-panel power input is a locking 4-pin Hirose connector (mapped to xlr4-dc, the closest available id — not a true XLR); the L/R analog line outputs use TA3 (3-pin mini-XLR) connectors (mapped to xlr3, the closest available id — physically smaller than full-size XLR3). The camera-trigger timecode input is Micro-HDMI per the spec sheet ("HDMI (micro)"), not full-size HDMI. Two BNC ports are menu-switchable between LTC timecode and word clock, not SDI video, so no SDI grade was applied. USB-A grade (usb-2.0) is inferred from the device's overall "Class-compliant USB 2.0 high speed" spec rather than a USB-A-specific statement. Not included as ports: the SD card slot and the battery-sled contacts (AA/L-mount), since neither is a connector type in the provided id list. Device is a handheld/portable field recorder-mixer, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Dimensions 36 x 206 x 175 mm, 0.91 kg unpackaged.
